name: Winter Arc shirt reveal checklist
description: One locked-camera monochrome rear-view take in which a subject removes a shirt, reveals a flexed back, and holds beneath a persistent challenge checklist.
lockedGrammar: One uninterrupted natural-real-time take from a locked rear-view vertical camera
High-contrast monochrome silhouette against a bright gym doorway
Subject raises hands, removes the shirt overhead, reveals the back and completes a double-biceps flex
Clothing, arms, shoulders and back move causally without a body morph
A centered yellow serif challenge checklist remains deterministic and persistent
Audio is added during finishing and is independent of generated motion

variables.description: One fictional or authorized adult identity used throughout the take.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional athletic adult with a consistent rear silhouette, hair and body
examples: a fictional muscular man with short dark curls
a fictional athletic woman with a dark bun

variables.description: Gender presentation preserved through the one-take reveal.
Opening shirt, cap or hairstyle, and lower-body training clothes.
variables.defaultValue: a plain black T-shirt, dark training shorts and an unbranded black cap
examples: a loose grey tee and black leggings

variables.description: Backlit environment for the fixed rear-view reveal.
variables.defaultValue: a gym entrance with a bright weight room beyond, mirrors, a bag and subtle background activity

variables.description: Exact deterministic heading above the challenge list.
Exact numbered challenge items rendered beneath the heading.
variables.defaultValue: 1. Water only; 2. No junk food; 3. 7-8 hours sleep; 4. Gym 4x per week; 5. Run 1x per week; 6. 10k steps daily; 7. No phone during meals; 8. 20 min outside daily; 9. Be grateful daily; 10. Track 5 daily wins

variables.description: A subtle app integration placed naturally in one tracking-oriented checklist item.
Authorized source audio or a rights-safe replacement.
variables.defaultValue: new royalty-cleared motivational audio synchronized to the back reveal

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Show {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation from behind in {{setting}}, wearing {{wardrobe}}, as a high-contrast monochrome silhouette from a locked vertical phone camera.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: In one uninterrupted real-time take, raise both hands to the collar, pull the shirt naturally overhead, clear both arms, reveal the back, complete a strong double-biceps and lat flex, then breathe and hold. Preserve identity and causal fabric/body motion.

deterministicLayers.template: Render ‘{{checklist_title}}’ and the numbered items ‘{{checklist_items}}’ as centered yellow serif text; naturally replace the final tracking-oriented item with ‘{{product_promo}}’ when a product is requested.
Apply {{audio_policy}} without changing the locked visual timeline.

promptExamples: Use the Winter Arc shirt-reveal format with a fictional male subject and make item 10 ‘Track workouts in GymLevels’.
Create the one-take checklist reveal with a fictional woman and a five-item GymLevels consistency challenge.

notes: Linked on 2026-09-03 to validator-accepted Fidelity Map fm-winter-arc-shirt-reveal-checklist-v1 (fixtures/fidelity-maps/fm-winter-arc-shirt-reveal-checklist-v1.json), materialized from the persisted analyzer output and deterministic scene detection for this source.
